body.message:
As per your request, please find the 4-month rates for Cloud Tower

August: AED 4,000
September: AED 5,500
October: AED 7,000
November: AED 8,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

If you wish to block the unit for 04 months we need to have the 1st and the last month payment in advance along with the security deposit

Thank you.
